notes.title: New Game "Nice City" page is live today, wishlist please!
notes.notes:
Hey folks, thank you for your continuous support!

My new game "Nice City" has officially launched its store page today! I hope everyone can help wishlist it.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4028160/_/

This new title is a 3D open-world RPG with multiplayer support, and of course it will feature an engaging story along with characters from "Campus Fantasy" and "Return to Campus" (like Xiao Hei) who travel through time. It's scheduled to launch in Q1 2026.

Additionally, at the end of this month during the National Day holiday, "Campus Fantasy" will receive a major update! This update will primarily conclude the main storyline about the poor kid. Thank you all for your ongoing support! If you want to experience more of the subsequent complete storyline, you can go play "Campus Fantasy"!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45189961/1f01492813c6eed4a6d81efa7315bd6629dd3db6.png[/img]

Once again, thank you all for your support!

Nie Yuxing

notes.title: Campus Fantasy (the Full Version of Return to campus) will be officially releas
notes.notes:
[p]Hey, guys! I'm Nie Yuxing.
Thank you all for your support along the way! Campus Fantasy  (the Full Version of Return to campus) is finally finished! It will be officially released on July 12th. The initial release price is $11.99. Bro who you have purchased the Bro Support Pack will get an additional discount. After the discount, it will cost about $8.3 (about $3.6 cheaper). I hope you'll all come and support it when the time comes!
In Campus Fantasy, apart from the complete storyline (rich kids + poor kids), there are also brand - new gameplay elements such as a dating system. I hope you'll like it.

notes.title: Urgent update
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where the home ground disappeared after the update
Fixed restaurant model disappearing
Fixed an issue where catching thieves would occasionally not trigger
Optimized lighting quality, there is now less noise

notes.title: Major update！
notes.notes:
Upgraded the underlying rendering system and refactored the code for better performance.
Unlimited framerate has been unlocked for 40+ graphics cards, and DLSS4 is now supported for up to 4x frame interpolation.
Upgraded the underlying code of the Unreal 5 engine, now the light tracing system lumen can refresh at 60 fps with better efficiency.
Supported megalight for complex light scenes, which supports stacking of a large number of moving light sources, and improved frame rate for complex light scenes.
Optimized the situation that the new school will fail to get out of the jam.
Optimized some episodes that can't be skipped

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)
